metadata.description: blueboard: Sentinel analytics rule (board-identity-misuse). Generated from docs/SECURITY.md detections.
Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled

properties.displayName: blueboard: board managed identity signed in from outside the board
properties.description: The board identity (blueboard-id-api) holds tenant-wide Graph and Defender permissions. A sign-in not attributed to the board Function App resource suggests its credential is being used elsewhere. Set the identity name if you changed namePrefix.
properties.query:
let boardIdentity = "blueboard-id-api";
AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
| where ServicePrincipalName == boardIdentity
| where ResourceIdentity !has "Microsoft.Web/sites"
| project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, ResourceDisplayName, ResourceIdentity, IPAddress
